title: Pig with sparkly eyes
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- Body -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='62' rx='32' ry='26' fill='#ff9eb5'/>
  <!-- Head -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='26' ry='24' fill='#ffb3c6'/>
  <!-- Ears -->
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='18' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#ff8fab' transform='rotate(-20 28 18)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='18' rx='9' ry='12' fill='#ff8fab' transform='rotate(20 72 18)'/>
  <ellipse cx='28' cy='18' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#ffc2d1' transform='rotate(-20 28 18)'/>
  <ellipse cx='72' cy='18' rx='5' ry='7' fill='#ffc2d1' transform='rotate(20 72 18)'/>
  <!-- Legs -->
  <rect x='27' y='80' width='12' height='14' rx='5' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <rect x='61' y='80' width='12' height='14' rx='5' fill='#ff8fab'/>
  <!-- Eyes - whites -->
  <ellipse cx='39' cy='34' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <ellipse cx='61' cy='34' rx='8' ry='9' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Pupils -->
  <circle cx='40' cy='34' r='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='34' r='5' fill='#3a2a4a'/>
  <!-- Sparkles in eyes -->
  <circle cx='42' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='64' cy='31' r='2.5' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='38' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='37' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- Snout -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='47' rx='13' ry='9' fill='#ff6b8a'/>
  <!-- Nostrils -->
  <ellipse cx='45' cy='47' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#d94f6e'/>
  <ellipse cx='55' cy='47' rx='2.5' ry='3.5' fill='#d94f6e'/>
  <!-- Smile -->
  <path d='M42 55 Q50 62 58 55' stroke='#d94f6e' stroke-width='2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- Cheeks -->
  <circle cx='30' cy='44' r='5' fill='#ff7a9e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='44' r='5' fill='#ff7a9e' opacity='0.6'/>
  <!-- Curly tail -->
  <path d='M82 60 Q90 55 88 65 Q86 73 80 68' stroke='#ff6b8a' stroke-width='3' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
</svg>
